conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.0 (FY-end backlog +23%, 金商法 +36%, while Q4 sales grew only 2.2%, which points to Q1 revenue arriving early against the company's own +10.9% OP guide, net of Pronexus's weak organic June season). I emit +0.8 because the release lands at 15:00 with the TSE open until 15:30, so part of any reaction is inside the entry close, and last year a Q1 that grew but lagged the guide pace was sold -2.36% in the scored window.
bar: Company guide FY2027/5 OP 4,900百万円 (sales 34,200) from the 2026年5月期 決算短信 of 2026-07-08 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260707589312.pdf), times the Q1 progress rate of 38.7% (FY26: 1,712/4,420) to 40.8% (FY25: 1,651/4,048) (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7921). That makes the Q1 OP bar about 1,900-2,000百万円, midpoint ~1,945. No sell-side consensus was found: Yahoo earningsHistory carries no estimates. My central Q1 OP is ~2,000 (+17% YoY), about +3% against the bar. Sourced to a company guide, so sizes are not capped for an unsourced bar.
positioning_check: No holder is on the JPX disclosed short register at or above 0.5% (baseline, as of 2026-09-18, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). Margin balances on kabutan as of 2026-09-25 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=7921): 売り残 9.7k shares, 買い残 32.4k, 信用倍率 3.34, up from 1.61 on 08-28 as margin shorts fell from 17.9k to 9.7k. Against ~20k shares a day of volume that is under one day to cover and ~0.07% of 13.15m shares outstanding, so there is no squeeze fuel and no crowded long. There is no option skew in Japan. priced_lean_pct is +0.05, i.e. neutral. The -6.15% 20-day slide follows the 08-25 株主優待 details, which disappointed yield and 優待 holders on the Yahoo board (https://finance.yahoo.co.jp/quote/7921.T/forum). That was sentiment, not a fundamental datum.

findings.finding: The FY2026/5 決算短信 shows the order backlog at 2026-05-31 up 23.0% YoY: total 7,979百万円 against 6,488, disclosure segment 7,969 against 6,470 (+1,499), and 金商法関連 (有報 etc.) 4,706 against 3,465 (+35.8%). Orders ran +10.7%, yet Q4 (Mar-May) sales grew only +2.2%. The work was booked but not yet billed going into the June 有報 peak, which falls in Q1 (Jun-Aug). A year earlier the backlog fell 2.8% and Q1 still grew sales +8.6%. So Q1 FY27 sales of ~+9-12% and OP of ~+12-22% (progress ~40-42% of 4,900, against 38.7% last year) are the likely outcome. Net of the peer read-through below.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Actual release dates are from kabutan, and each move runs from the D close (15:30) to the D+1 close off Yahoo daily bars. Q1 FY26 (2025-09-29): sales +8.6% and OP +3.7%, below that year's +8.7% OP guide pace; D -0.24%, then -2.36%. Q1 FY25 (2024-09-30): OP down YoY; -2.58% next session (the Yahoo D-1 bar for that date looks corrupt). Other prints ran -0.70%, +0.32%, +1.56% and +1.20%. The two guide/dividend prints moved +3.35% and +8.03% (the latter after +18% in the final 30 minutes of D). Quarterly beats have not been bought much; the FY guide line moves this stock.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline on 07-08 was the +60 yen dividend and the 中期経営計画2029 (kabutan: '今期は営業益11%増を計画し年間配当予想は60円増配'). The 受注残高 table sits on page 3 of the 短信. No analyst covers the name, so nothing turns it into a Q1 estimate. Since then the stock has given back its post-results high (4,395 on 08-28 to 4,045) on 優待 disappointment, and the Yahoo board argues about 優待 and 配当, not orders. If the backlog were priced, the pre-print drift would be up rather than -6% over 20 days, and holders would be discussing the Q1 progress rate.
findings.independence: Cross-checked against last year's backlog table (FY2025/5 決算短信, https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20250709/140120250708509794.pdf: backlog -2.8% at 2025-05-31, followed by Q1 sales +8.6%) and the Q4 sales from kabutan's 3-month table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=7921). Those are two readings from the company's own documents, so they count once. The one different-source datum points the other way: Pronexus (7893) Q1 Apr-Jun 2026 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260730503996.pdf) shows sales +5.3%, mostly from M&A, and OP +0.4%. 招集通知 revenue fell (about 90 fewer listed companies, electronic provision cutting print pages) and English translation orders fell. That drag is already netted into the +1.0; without it I would size about +1.5. A primary company document beats an industry proxy, so the peer read cuts the size but does not flip the sign.

baseline_tension: The finding leans mildly positive against a neutral lean (+0.05), a -6.15% 20-day run-up and falling margin shorts. The run-up weakness looks like 優待 disappointment, not a fundamental read, so the finding cuts slightly against the tape and does not agree with positioning. The price-structure caveat (a 15:00 release inside the 15:30 close) and last year's sold Q1 are why the emitted +0.8 is below the +1.0 finding.
